sources.notes: Road surfaces are triangulated directly between this layout's saved road boundaries. Elevation follows the approximately 79 m terrain raster, not a survey of the road. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations on curved boundaries; their locations, widths, heights and colours are assumed, not extracted from imagery. Banking is unknown. The source is an open route or branch network, without one validated closed driving order. Choose an embedded component route for playback and recording; this network does not represent a single lap. Boundary coordinates and their separate feature-level licence are preserved. Imagery loads externally on demand; no image bytes or meshes are stored.

notes: Draft configuration: Full course with direct northern corner and southeastern linked bends; excludes the extra northern chicane. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 4090.0 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

supersedes.reason: The original outer border has an inward spur across the paved pit straight. Complete independent sparse NAIP observations reconstruct the selected road limits while preserving the provisional source route; openings and shadowed gaps remain interpolated.

measurement.note: Road Atlanta full draft route: 266 sparse image observations plus two repeated closure anchors on the pinned NAIP image, at roughly 30 m spacing. Offsets independently read to 0.5 m; rounding and pixel size are not survey accuracy. Limits follow the asphalt side of visible curbs, paint, grass and surface transitions, excluding adjoining runoff and pit roads. No anchor is claimed on the negative-normal edge at stations 20, 630, 640 and 730, or the positive-normal edge at 990, 1260, 1310 and 1320, because of openings or obscuring shadows. These gaps and all other unmeasured intervals interpolate. Remaining shadow and texture interpretation add uncertainty. Source route identity and historical alignment remain provisional. No automatic border coordinates were used.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Road Atlanta SRO Practice: 254 supported observations reused from the full route on the same pinned NAIP image, with 12 independently located observations for the differing source section, plus two closure anchors. Shared projection requires nearby source stations and matching driving direction; unsupported sections were measured independently. Limits follow the selected asphalt/paint/curb/grass transitions and exclude adjoining runoff and pit access. Offsets read to 0.5 m; imagery and rounding are not survey accuracy. Openings, shadows and all unmeasured intervals interpolate; source identity and historical alignment remain provisional. No automatic proposal coordinates were used.
